extension.description: PVR Client for EON which allows you to watch live TV channels and listen to radio stations. Supports TV-Guide (EPG) and 7-day rewind.
PVR Client for EON which allows you to watch live TV channels and listen to radio stations. Supports TV-Guide (EPG) and 7-day rewind.
PVR-Client für EON, mit dem Sie TV-Sender live ansehen und Radiosender hören können. Unterstützt TV-Guide (EPG) und 7-Tage-Rücklauf.
PVR klijent za EON koji vam omogućava da gledate TV kanale uživo i slušate radio stanice. Podržava EPG (TV vodič) i 7-dnevno vraćanje unazad.
PVR клијент за EON који вам омогућава да гледате TV канале уживо и слушате радио станице. Подржава EPG (TV водич) и 7-дневно враћање уназад.
PVR klijent za EON koji vam omogućuje gledanje TV programa uživo i slušanje radijskih postaja. Podržava EPG (TV vodič) i 7-dnevno vraćanje unazad.
PVR klijent za EON koji vam omogućava da gledate TV kanale uživo i slušate radio stanice. Podržava EPG (TV vodič) i 7-dnevno vraćanje unazad.
Odjemalec PVR za EON, ki omogoča gledanje televizijskih programov v živo in poslušanje radijskih postaj. Podpira EPG (TV spored) in 7-dnevno previjanje nazaj.
PVR клиент за EON кој ви овозможува да гледате ТВ канали во живо и да слушате радио станици. Поддржува EPG (ТВ водич) и 7-дневно враќање назад.
PVR клиент за EON, който ви позволява да гледате на живо телевизионни канали и да слушате радиостанции. Поддържа електронен програмен справочник (EPG) и 7-дневно връщане назад.
Πελάτης PVR για το EON που σας επιτρέπει να παρακολουθείτε τηλεοπτικά κανάλια ζωντανά και να ακούτε ραδιοφωνικούς σταθμούς. Υποστηρίζει EPG (οδηγό προγράμματος) και επαναφορά 7 ημερών.

extension.news:
[COLOR yellow][B]EON PVR Client for LibreELEC (RPi - aarch64)[/B][/COLOR]
This is the EON.tv PVR client addon for Kodi. It provides Kodi integration for the streaming provider [B]EON.tv[/B]. A user account / paid subscription is required to use this addon. Please create the user account outside of this addon. Please enter the username/password to the configuration of this addon. Some content is geo-blocked.
[B]Supported service providers[/B] - SBB - Telemach - Telemach HR - Telemach SI - Vivacom - Nova
[B]Features[/B] Live TV and Radio EPG Replay (including restart of current event)
[B]Notes[/B] - Tested building it for Linux x86_64, Linux armv7, Linux aarch64, Android armv7, and Android aarch64 - Depends on inputstream addon - [B]For seeking/rewind (live TV and replay/catchup) to work[/B], set the addon's "Select Inputstream" setting to 'inputstream.ffmpegdirect' -- it defaults to 'inputstream.adaptive', which doesn't support seeking with this addon - Standard inputstream-based Replay TV still behaves like a short rolling live HLS window on EON/Vivacom, so full seek/rewind is limited there - 'Experimental native archive streaming' adds working archive seek support for finished replay programmes and for 'EPG -> Play programme' on already-started events - Direct live channel 'Switch' still uses the standard live playback path and does not yet expose the native archive/timeshift behavior
[B]Disclaimer[/B] This addon is inofficial and not linked in any form to eon.tv All trademarks belong to them
